payload.explanation: support-agent reads crm, which holds restricted data, and writes to scratchpad — shared state that is not part of the declared architecture. reporting-agent reads from that same resource and sends to webhook, outside the estate. Each action is individually permitted; together they compose a route from restricted data to external egress that no single agent was granted and the architecture does not allow.
